title: 第2578章 逆行第2577章 暂离漩涡中心
content_zh:
四人踏上了行程。
杨素竟然弄了两辆马车，雷横和杨素一辆马车，张楚和童青山一辆。
马有灵性，能认路，雷横和杨素一上路，就钻到了车轿内，任由那马自己找方向。
张楚和童青山一脸的无语，觉得这俩人的精力，似乎过于旺盛了。
但两人也理解，雷横的目标很明确，让杨素怀上他的娃，以后他就能经常去剑庐苏氏了。
于是，两辆马车一前一后，向着云瓮城的方向走去。
中午时分，雷横忽然掀开马车的轿帘，对张楚和童青山说道：
“去云瓮城，大概需要三天的时间。”
张楚点头：“不着急。”
雷横又急忙钻了回去……
走了大半日，张楚发现路上的人渐渐多了起来，且都是跟张楚和童青山逆行。
这些人，大多是十八九岁的年轻人，三三两两地结伴而行，有的背着包袱，有的佩着短刀，脚步轻快朝着木家镇的方向赶。
他们的修为普遍不高，大多都是幽觉了两次的年轻人。
再次遇到一队少年人的时候，张楚拦住了他们。
那是五个少年，四男一女，年纪都不大，十七八岁的模样，结着伴走在官道边上。
张楚拱拱手，开口问道：“几位小友这是去哪里？”
领头的一个少年停下脚步，上下打量了张楚一眼，开口道：
“去木家镇啊，周围几十座大城的年轻人，都往那边赶呢。”
张楚笑道：“我就是从木家镇来的，你们这个修为，去了恐怕抢不到什么宝物，反倒可能送了性命。”
那穿红袄的少女插嘴道：“我们可不是去抢夺造化的，既然你们来自木家镇，难道不知道那里要举行收徒盛典吗？”

“收徒盛典？”
张楚还真没听说过。
此时少女说道：“几大名门在那边设了考核台，允许周围几十座大城的年轻人去参加考核，若是考核成功，便能进入八大名门呢。”
另一个少年说道：“这可是千载难逢的好机会！”
“是啊，我们都是去参加考核的，若是有机会进入八大名门，那就是一步登天！”
……
张楚告别了这队少年，神色古怪起来，收徒盛典？我怎么没听说过。
这时候杨素已经整理好衣衫，坐在了车头，雷横则是坐在她身后，搂着她的腰。
一个看起来冷冷清清的仙子，一个满脸不正经的糙汉，看起来很违和，但又真实的发生了。
杨素看到张楚和童青山疑惑，随口道：“确实在举行收徒盛典，但跟你们没关系。”
童青山一听就不服了。
他和张楚之前想加入名门，结果被剑庐苏氏拒绝了，现在有了机会，凭什么说跟他们没关系？
他不由问杨素：“为什么跟我们没关系？”
杨素淡淡的说道：“这次收徒盛典，确实传遍了附近几十座大城，但要的是二十岁以下的年轻人，你们的年龄早就过了。”
雷横也说道：“不错，这个消息我也听说过，所以没告诉你们，免得你们不舒服。”
张楚微微皱眉：“为什么是二十岁以下？”
杨素解释道：“收徒是假，真正的目标，还是在寻找那个触发了幽眼列苍穹的超级天才。”
“啊？”
content_en:
The four of them embarked on the journey.
Yang Su actually got two carriages, one for Lei Heng and Yang Su, and one for Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan.
Horses are intelligent and can recognize the road. As soon as Lei Heng and Yang Su got on the road, they got into the carriage and let the horse find its own direction.
Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan were speechless, feeling that their energy seemed too strong.
But the two of them also understood that Lei Heng's goal was very clear, to make Yang Su pregnant with his baby, so that he could go to Jianlu Su's family frequently in the future.
So, the two carriages walked in the direction of Yunweng City, one behind the other.
At noon, Lei Heng suddenly opened the curtain of the carriage and said to Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan:
"It will take about three days to get to Yunweng City."
Zhang Chu nodded: "Don't worry."
Lei Heng hurriedly went back...
After walking for more than half a day, Zhang Chu found that there were gradually more and more people on the road, and they were all going the wrong way with Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan.
These people, mostly young people of eighteen or nineteen years old, walked together in twos and threes, some carrying baggage, some wearing short knives, walking briskly in the direction of Mujia Town.
Their cultivation levels are generally not high, and most of them are young people who have slept twice.
When he met a group of young people again, Zhang Chu stopped them.
They were five young men, four boys and one girl, all young, about seventeen or eighteen years old, walking together on the edge of the official road.
Zhang Chugong cupped his hands and asked, "Where are you guys going?"
The leading boy stopped, looked Zhang Chu up and down, and said:
"Go to Mujia Town. Young people from dozens of big cities around are rushing there."
Zhang Chu said with a smile: "I came from Mujia Town. With your cultivation level, I'm afraid you won't be able to grab any treasures. Instead, you may lose your life."
The girl in the red coat interjected: "We are not here to rob the good fortune. Since you are from Mujia Town, don't you know that a ceremony to recruit disciples will be held there?"
"Disciple Recruitment Ceremony?"
Zhang Chu has never heard of it.
At this time, the girl said: "Several famous sects have set up assessment desks there, allowing young people from dozens of surrounding big cities to take the assessment. If they succeed in the assessment, they can enter the eight famous sects."
Another young man said: "This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!"
"Yes, we are all going to take the assessment. If we have a chance to enter the eight famous families, we will reach the sky in one step!"
…
Zhang Chu bid farewell to the group of young men and looked strange. A grand ceremony for accepting disciples? Why haven't I heard of it?
At this time, Yang Su had already arranged her clothes and sat at the front of the car, while Lei Heng sat behind her and held her waist.
A fairy who looks cold and indifferent, and a rough man with an unruly face. They seem very inconsistent, but they really happened.
Seeing Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan's confusion, Yang Su said casually: "The apprenticeship ceremony is indeed being held, but it has nothing to do with you."
Tong Qingshan was dissatisfied upon hearing this.
He and Zhang Chu wanted to join a famous family before, but were rejected by the Jianlu Su family. Now that they have the opportunity, why should they say it has nothing to do with them?
He couldn't help but ask Yang Su: "Why does it have nothing to do with us?"
Yang Su said calmly: "This apprenticeship ceremony has indeed spread to dozens of nearby big cities, but the ones we want are young people under the age of twenty. Your age has long passed."
Lei Heng also said: "Yes, I have heard about this news, so I didn't tell you to avoid making you feel uncomfortable."
Zhang Chu frowned slightly: "Why are you under twenty years old?"
Yang Su explained: "The recruitment of disciples is a lie. The real goal is to find the super genius who triggered the Youyan column in the sky."
"Huh?"
